authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Planning Data reports 337 Local Planning Authorities and states that this dataset contains the administrative boundary for each LPA in England; providers are MHCLG and ONS and the dataset is OGL v3.0. This source family can provide the correct authority-boundary entity type for future-growth AREA_JOIN evidence in principle. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition still supplies no authoritative LPA reference, LAD/GSS code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate, local-plan-boundary reference, or equivalent identifier that binds the slot to one of the 337 LPAs. Selecting any LPA would be guessing. No source-area or parcel record accepted; no accepted Plan0 package emitted.
